SELECT D.CODE , D.CODE_NAME , D.CODE_NAME_ENG , D.CODE_NAME_LOC , D.SORT_NO , D.TXT_VALUE1 , D.TXT_VALUE2 , D.TXT_VALUE3 , D.TXT_VALUE4 , D.TXT_VALUE5 , D.NUM_VALUE1 , D.NUM_VALUE2 , D.NUM_VALUE3 , D.NUM_VALUE4 , D.NUM_VALUE5 , D.USING_YN FROM CODE_DTL D WHERE D.CATEGORY = #{category} AND D.COMPANY_CODE = #{company_code} AND D.DELETE_YN = 'N' ORDER BY D.SORT_NO, D.CODE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CODE_DTL ( CODE, CATEGORY, COMPANY_CODE, CODE_NAME, CODE_NAME_ENG, CODE_NAME_LOC, SORT_NO, TXT_VALUE1, TXT_VALUE2, TXT_VALUE3, TXT_VALUE4, TXT_VALUE5, NUM_VALUE1, NUM_VALUE2, NUM_VALUE3, NUM_VALUE4, NUM_VALUE5, USING_YN, DELETE_YN, CREATE_DATE, CREATE_BY, UPDATE_DATE, UPDATE_BY ) VALUES ( #{code}, #{category}, #{company_code}, #{code_name}, NULLIF(#{code_name_eng}, ''), NULLIF(#{code_name_loc}, ''), #{sort_no}, NULLIF(#{txt_value1}, ''), NULLIF(#{txt_value2}, ''), NULLIF(#{txt_value3}, ''), NULLIF(#{txt_value4}, ''), NULLIF(#{txt_value5}, ''), CAST(NULLIF(CAST(#{num_value1} AS VARCHAR), '') AS NUMERIC(32,0)), CAST(NULLIF(CAST(#{num_value2} AS VARCHAR), '') AS NUMERIC(32,0)), CAST(NULLIF(CAST(#{num_value3} AS VARCHAR), '') AS NUMERIC(32,0)), CAST(NULLIF(CAST(#{num_value4} AS VARCHAR), '') AS NUMERIC(32,0)), CAST(NULLIF(CAST(#{num_value5} AS VARCHAR), '') AS NUMERIC(32,0)), #{using_yn}, 'N', NOW(), #{update_by}, NOW(), #{update_by} ) ON CONFLICT (CODE, CATEGORY, COMPANY_CODE) DO UPDATE SET CODE_NAME = EXCLUDED.CODE_NAME, CODE_NAME_ENG = EXCLUDED.CODE_NAME_ENG, CODE_NAME_LOC = EXCLUDED.CODE_NAME_LOC, SORT_NO = EXCLUDED.SORT_NO, TXT_VALUE1 = EXCLUDED.TXT_VALUE1, TXT_VALUE2 = EXCLUDED.TXT_VALUE2, TXT_VALUE3 = EXCLUDED.TXT_VALUE3, TXT_VALUE4 = EXCLUDED.TXT_VALUE4, TXT_VALUE5 = EXCLUDED.TXT_VALUE5, NUM_VALUE1 = EXCLUDED.NUM_VALUE1, NUM_VALUE2 = EXCLUDED.NUM_VALUE2, NUM_VALUE3 = EXCLUDED.NUM_VALUE3, NUM_VALUE4 = EXCLUDED.NUM_VALUE4, NUM_VALUE5 = EXCLUDED.NUM_VALUE5, USING_YN = EXCLUDED.USING_YN, DELETE_YN = 'N', UPDATE_DATE = NOW(), UPDATE_BY = EXCLUDED.UPDATE_BY
